# Reset Your Mind 1111™

> Recalibrate your Worth Thermostat across health, wealth, love, and leadership. A nervous-system-level reset app by Lorie Wu, The Emotional Surgeon.

Reset Your Mind 1111 helps people break patterns that keep them settling for crumbs. The app pairs a free Worth Thermostat assessment with oracle cards, guided meditations, daily permission slips, a 30-day reset journey, and an emotional-surgery curriculum.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with the Worth Thermostat assessment and program overview.
- [Mission](/mission): Lorie Wu's mission and positioning behind Reset Your Mind 1111.
- [Worth Thermostat Assessment](/assessment): Free 25-question, 3-minute assessment.
- [Manifesto](/manifesto): The Reset Your Mind 1111 manifesto.
